The PR replaces whole-file tracked-file scanning with parsing of line-numbered `git grep` matches, updates the declaration surface, and expands regression coverage.

PR surface: Tests +117, Other +41. Total +158 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: create a tracked filename containing a newline and a conflict marker, then run the current parser path; splitting stdout before its NUL-delimited pathname is parsed corrupts the record. This review did not execute the reproduction because the checkout is read-only.

target.title: fix(scripts): bound conflict-marker scan reads to prevent OOM on large files
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`pnpm check:no-conflict-markers` previously read every candidate tracked file returned by `git grep` into memory whole via `fs.readFileSync`. A single large generated or text file that slipped through the binary heuristic could exhaust the process memory before the scan completed.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Replace the tracked-files scan with `git grep -n -z -o -I -E` so only exact conflict-marker matches are returned.
- Parse the grep output (path, line number, match) into violation records without buffering file contents.
- Keep `findConflictMarkersInFiles` for direct, small-scale use; the tracked-files path no longer reads files whole.
- `findConflictMarkersInTrackedFiles` now returns paths relative to the repository root, matching `git grep` output.

## User Impact

- Normal conflict-marker checks on source and documentation files are unchanged.
- Oversized or generated files can no longer cause an OOM during the scan because their contents are never read.
- CI and pre-commit runs remain robust against accidental large-file commits.

## Evidence

Local focused test passes:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.test.ts --run
```

Result:

```
✓ |tooling| test/scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.test.ts (9 tests) 585ms
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  9 passed (9)
```

Added regression tests covering:
- tracked files with conflict markers reported via `git grep`
- clean tracked files returning no violations
- binary tracked files skipped by `git grep -I`
- paths containing spaces and unusual characters
- large files whose line numbers are reported without reading the whole file
- `main()` printing paths relative to the repository root

Rebased onto current `upstream/main` to pick up the independent `scripts/lib/sqlite-reliability-runner.ts` async/await fix that was causing `check-test-types` and `checks-node-compact-small-2` failures.
